episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Connie Mortensen commits a terrible, unimaginable, crime.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Unearthing some surprising revelations, Emma becomes increasingly sympathetic to Connie's plight, but is she being manipulated into giving too much away about her own dark past?

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Emma learns the truth behind Connie's actions and confronts her own demons, but will it be enough to convince a jury Connie is no longer a danger to society?
